input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must be signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents, including the moving piece, and the move path of a piece that has gone off plan (pawn_a7, rook_a8, queen_d8) must also be co-signed by king_e8 and at least thirteen other agents, so a lone off-plan agent can never get its move accepted.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false))
